title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 30
description: Ten questions on Genesis 30: the sons born to Jacob, the mandrakes, the birth of Joseph and Jacob's flocks.

questions.text: What did Rachel say to Jacob when she envied her sister?
questions.explanation: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, she envied her sister and said, "Give me children, or else I will die."

answers.text: "Give me children, or else I will die."
"Send me back to my father's house."
"Give me your blessing before you go."
"Let me go out to the field."

questions.text: What name did Rachel give the first son born to Bilhah?
questions.explanation: Bilhah bore Jacob a son, and Rachel said, "God has judged me," and called his name Dan.

questions.text: What did Rachel say when she named Naphtali?
questions.explanation: Rachel said, "I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed." She named him Naphtali.

answers.text: "God has judged me, and has also heard my voice."
"I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings."
"Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy."

questions.text: What did Reuben find in the field during the wheat harvest?
questions.explanation: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother Leah.

questions.text: Which son did Leah name with the words "God has given me my hire"?
questions.explanation: Leah bore Jacob a fifth son and said, "God has given me my hire." She named him Issachar.

questions.text: What was the name of the daughter Leah bore?
questions.explanation: Afterwards Leah bore a daughter and named her Dinah.

questions.text: What did Rachel say when she named Joseph?
questions.explanation: She named him Joseph, saying, "May Yahweh add another son to me."

answers.text: "Now my husband will live with me."
"May Yahweh add another son to me."

questions.text: Why did Laban want Jacob to stay with him?
questions.explanation: Laban said, "Stay here, for I have divined that Yahweh has blessed me for your sake."

answers.text: He needed Jacob to repay a debt
His sons were too young to keep the flock
He had divined that Yahweh blessed him for Jacob's sake
He wanted Jacob to marry another daughter

questions.text: What did Jacob ask for as his hire?
questions.explanation: Jacob said he would remove every speckled and spotted one, every black one among the sheep and the spotted and speckled among the goats: "This will be my hire."

answers.text: The speckled and spotted animals and the black sheep
A tenth of all the young of Laban's flocks
Thirty camels with their colts and ten donkeys
Silver and a field of his own near Haran

questions.text: From which trees did Jacob take fresh rods to peel?
questions.explanation: Jacob took rods of fresh poplar, almond and plane tree and peeled white streaks in them.
